finding: Rapid-click Add (4 clicks within ~100ms) inserts 4 duplicate transcript lines; the note draft de-duplicates the text but the transcript feed and 'lines recorded' counter show 4 entries, and only 1 POST is required to create them
steps: Type 'Rapid click tooth 14' into quick-observation input
Click Add 4 times programmatically within ~100ms (equivalent to an anxious double-click × 2)
Wait 800ms; read transcript feed + note canvas
expected: Either the button is disabled for the in-flight add (as it appears between renders — 'Add' shows disabled when input is empty) or the add is idempotent; transcript should contain 1 line.
actual: Transcript feed shows 4 identical 'Dialogue' rows at the same timestamp (10:06:50 AM), counter shows '4 lines recorded', note canvas contains the text once (de-duplicated by the draft engine's exact-text merge).
risk: Low-moderate: inflated line counts, duplicate evidence rows in the transcript that a grounding check treats as repeated independent utterances. The note draft absorbed it; the persisted transcript does not.
